Texas Foreclosures Are Skyrocketing But There’s Something No One’s Talking About
Welcome to your full July 2025 Texas Real Estate Market Update! Whether you're buying, selling, investing, or just keeping an eye on the housing market, this video is packed with everything you need to know about what’s happening in real estate across the Lone Star State.

In this comprehensive update, we dive deep into the latest data for major Texas markets, including Dallas-Fort Worth, Austin, Houston, San Antonio, El Paso, Copperas Cove, Fort Hood (Bell County), and more. You'll get a clear picture of what’s really happening on the ground—from home prices and days on market to inventory shifts and rental trends.

We take a closer look at how rising interest rates are impacting affordability and pricing, which markets are seeing the biggest price drops, and where buyers and sellers are finding opportunities. You’ll also hear real-world insight on whether now is a good time to buy or wait, how to avoid overpaying, and why holding real estate long term might still be the smartest play.

We cover:
✅ Median home prices & rent trends
✅ Inventory levels & days on market
✅ Price decrease & relist rates
✅ New construction impact
✅ Expert advice for homebuyers & sellers
✅ Long-term investment strategies
✅ What rising interest rates mean for the future

Whether you're a first-time buyer, investor, or just real estate curious, this video gives you an honest and up-to-date look at what’s really happening across the state. Spoiler: the market is shifting, but opportunities are still out there—for those who know where and how to look. 👀
